'''Kyl:''' {{legend0|#d75d5d|60–70%}} {{legend0|#d72f30|70–80%}} {{legend0|#c21b18|80–90%}} | title = U.S. Senator | before_election = [[Jon Kyl]] | before_party = Republican Party (United States) | after_election = [[Jon Kyl]] | after_party = Republican Party (United States) }} {{Elections in Arizona}} The '''2000 United States Senate election in Arizona''' was held on November 7, 2000. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator [[Jon Kyl]] won re-election to a second term. No candidate was nominated from the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic Party]]. Independent Bill Toel, Green party nominee Vance Hansen, and Libertarian party nominee Barry Hess each got more than 5% of the vote, a strong non-major-party performance. ==Candidates== ===Green=== * Vance Hansen, retired teacher ===Independent=== * Bill Toel, professor and former banker{{cite web | title= Where the Candidates Stand |
